name: Pulse Analytics
description: Privacy-first web analytics. No cookies, no IP addresses stored, and the script it adds to your pages is under 3 KB.

fields.name: domain
fields.label: Domain
fields.description: The domain this site is registered under in Pulse, e.g. example.com. Leave empty to let the tracker use the browser's own hostname — correct for a site served on one domain.

fields.name: companion
fields.label: Record clicks, copies and form submits
fields.description: Enter true to load a second, separate script that records clicks, copies and form submits. It is a second request on purpose: the core script's size is a published claim and nothing is folded into it to make a feature look free. Leave empty or false to turn it off.

fields.name: api
fields.label: Custom API origin
fields.description: Optional. Route events through your own proxy origin, e.g. https://example.com. A bare origin, not a full URL — the tracker appends its own path. Leave empty unless you have set a proxy up.

execute_unsafe_scripts.description: Pulse Analytics adds a <script> element to the page pointing at js.ciphera.net/script.js (and, if enabled, a second one for the companion interaction script). No other client-side logic runs — the component does not read or write cookies, make its own network request, or touch anything else on the page.
